name: user_transaction_totals_v6
comment: The DDL-shaped snapshot (ADR-0017 add.1, dialect-neutral content since ADR-0043): views record their normalized defining DDL — whitespace collapsed, the create-view prefix canonicalized with `or alter`/`or replace`/`if not exists` and the name's quoting stripped — because the definition is the schema and the body is the one SQL the entity declares. Only the dialect stamp differs per dialect.

sqlite.ddl: create view user_transaction_totals as select u.id as user_id, u.name as user_name, count(t.id) as transaction_count, coalesce(sum(t.amount), 0) as total_amount, max(t.created_at) as last_transaction_at from users u left join transactions t on t.user_id = u.id group by u.id, u.name

sqlserver.ddl: create view user_transaction_totals as select u.id as user_id, u.name as user_name, count(t.id) as transaction_count, coalesce(sum(t.amount), 0) as total_amount, max(t.created_at) as last_transaction_at from users u left join transactions t on t.user_id = u.id group by u.id, u.name
